**Finding: missing** (rule IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data)

The Kubient MSA contains no IP/data ownership article at all:
- **p0025 (§6(a))** makes us "responsible and solely liable" for the Content and the IP rights in it — a liability allocation, not an ownership confirmation.
- **p0065 (§14(b))** addresses only party names, trademarks and logos.
- **p0039–p0040** are Kubient warranties about *its* rights in the Service and Auction Platform.
- Data flows to Kubient (Requests, visitor data under p0035) with no statement that we retain rights in it, and "deliverables" are referenced (p0033, p0040) with no ownership or licence-back provision.

There is no assignment of AP IP or data to Kubient, so this is not walk-away territory — but neither the preferred nor the fallback position is satisfied because no usable clause exists.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new §6(b) inserted after p0025 confirming AP retains all rights in Content, Properties, Requests and Customer Data; Kubient assigns deliverables/work product created for AP; Kubient retains the Auction Platform and its background technology/know-how and grants a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to any Kubient materials embedded in deliverables; no assignment of AP IP/data to Kubient, no joint ownership, and Kubient may use Customer Data only to provide the Services.
